_note: ESP Web Tools manifest for the HomeControl firmware (doc/network.md, 'Improv / web flasher'). The part paths are relative to this file. For local testing scripts/flasher-local.sh copies a build into firmware/esp32c6/ (not versioned). For a release the binaries are the GitHub release assets, https://github.com/haumacher/homecontrol/releases/download/<tag>/<asset> (pattern to be filled when the first release is cut); release downloads may lack CORS headers, in which case the release workflow copies the assets next to this manifest (GitHub Pages) instead. The layout is the single-app table until the OTA layout of issue #3 replaces it.
